description: Maintains an opt-in, repository-local project knowledge layer for stable architecture, invariants, decisions, regressions, commands, design rules, and project-scoped experience. Use when a project is revisited repeatedly and durable context would reduce rediscovery. Current repository/runtime evidence always outranks the brain; entries carry provenance/freshness; stale facts are retired; secrets and private chain-of-thought are forbidden; and repository files are created or changed only when durable project memory is explicitly authorized.
